Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 103: December 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #103 shipped to subscribers in November 2009 (bearing the cover date of December 2009 for Issue 103). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #103 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and exclusive media previews:

Bayonetta (stylish third-person action hack-and-slash)
Army of Two: The 40th Day (co-op third-person shooter)
Dante's Inferno (action-adventure hack-and-slash)
Dark Void (third-person vertical cover shooter)
Serious Sam HD: The First Encounter (Xbox Live Arcade FPS remaster)
Gyromancer (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle-RPG)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Mass Effect 2, Battlefield: Bad Company 2, and Halo: Reach, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
